SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY Id) ROW_NUM
  FROM (
        select Id, VersionNumber from documents where id=5 
        Union all  
        select Id, VersionNumber from versions where id=5
       ) a
order by VersionNumber desc


SELECT 
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY name ASC) AS Row#,
  name, recovery_model_desc
FROM sys.databases 
WHERE database_id < 5;



WITH RiskRatingSK AS (
SELECT ISNULL(MAX(RiskRatingSK),0) RN FROM DW.DimRiskRating
)

,TEMP_DW_RiskRating AS (
SELECT
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN  FROM RiskRatingSK) AS RiskRatingSK
,BCR.CreditRiskId AS RiskRatingID
,BCR.CreditRiskName AS RiskRatingName
,NULL AS RiskRatingDescription
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,Getdate() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,BCR.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
FROM
DW.DimBank DDB
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CreditRisk BCR ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCR.FinancialInstitutionId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,DDB.BankID)
WHERE BCR.SourceSystemCode = 'CRM'

UNION ALL

SELECT
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN  FROM RiskRatingSK) AS RiskRatingSK
,BCA.RiskRating AS RiskRatingID
,BCA.RiskRating AS RiskRatingName
,NULL AS RiskRatingDescription
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,Getdate() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,BCA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
FROM
DW.DimBank DDB
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CreditCardApplication BCA ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCA.FinancialInstitutionId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,DDB.BankID)

UNION ALL

SELECT
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN  FROM RiskRatingSK) AS RiskRatingSK
,BSC.RiskClass AS RiskRatingID
,BSC.RiskClass AS RiskRatingName
,NULL AS RiskRatingDescription
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,Getdate() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,BSC.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
FROM
DW.DimBank DDB
LEFT JOIN BNKM.SecuritiesCustomer BSC ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BSC.FinancialInstitutionId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,DDB.BankID)
)
SELECT * FROM TEMP_DW_RiskRating
--WHERE RiskRatingID IS NULL
order by RiskRatingSK


SELECT * FROM BNKM.CREDITRISK
WHERE CreditRiskId IS NULL

SELECT * FROM BNKM.CreditCardApplication
WHERE RiskRating IS NULL


SELECT  RiskClass,* FROM BNKM.SecuritiesCustomer
WHERE RiskClass = ''
